No teaching moment

Three links, one bio, no path

Someone who finds you through a post has to choose between coaching, a course and a newsletter on their own. Most people faced with a menu pick nothing.

No qualifier

Your best fits look like everyone else

The followers ready to invest in coaching scroll past the same posts as everyone else. Nothing asks them to raise their hand.

One hour at a time

Coaching sold by the hour caps you

A single one-hour session is a great taster, but it means every sale starts from zero. A coaching program sold to applicants changes the maths.

The people who love your content but aren't ready for coaching today have no clear next step, so most of them take none.

My recommendation

A free Radiant masterclass that sells your course and fills your coaching

You already have the products. What's missing is one free 60-minute class that teaches a real win, offers your course on the thank-you page, and invites the right people to apply for private coaching.

Fixes the missing teaching moment

One free class becomes the single front door in your bio. Every sign-up joins your email list, and every attendee gets a real win before you ask for anything.

Fixes the missing qualifier

The replay page asks the people who want more to apply. You only talk to people who watched, stayed and told you what they want.

Puts your courses to work

Your course stops waiting in a link list and gets offered at the exact moment people want the next step.

The 95%*

Not ready for coaching yet

They join the free class, pick up your course on the thank-you page, and keep hearing from you through your newsletter. They pay you while they build trust.

The qualified 5%

Ready for private coaching

They watch to the end and apply on the replay page. The application filters for fit before your diary, and three pre-call emails warm them up for your coaching program.

*The 95% / 5% split is an industry estimate, not your data.

Script 1 · Reel · 30 to 45 seconds

"You've saved 40 of my posts"

Hook
"If your saved folder is full of my posts and nothing has changed yet, this is for you." (to camera, close framing)
Body
"Saving tips feels like progress. But tips don't add up to a plan. What I do with my coaching clients is different: one approach, in order, with a first step you take straight away. I'm going to teach that live." (cut to Amy writing three steps in a notebook)
CTA
"It's a free 60-minute class called Radiant. Tap Sign up to save your seat."
Script 2 · Reel · 30 seconds

"Three questions"

Hook
"Answer these three questions and you'll know exactly where you're stuck." (on-screen text: 3 questions)
Body
"One: what do you actually want in 90 days? Two: what did you do about it this week? Three: who's helping you? If the answers were vague, nothing, and no one, that's not a motivation problem. It's a plan problem." (captions for each question)
CTA
"In my free masterclass I'll help you build the plan. Link below, it's free, and there's a replay."
Script 3 · Reel · 45 seconds

"Where do I start with you?"

Hook
"People ask me where to start: coaching, a course, or my newsletter. Here's my honest answer." (walking, warm light)
Body
"If you're new, don't pick yet. Come to my free class first. You'll learn how I work, take your first step with me live, and know which next step fits you."
CTA
